metadata.description: Astro dev server with HMR for the QAuth documentation site (Starlight).
Static build of the QAuth documentation site. Output lands at dist/apps/docs-site via astro.config.mjs's outDir.

Type-check via `astro check` (checks .astro/.mdx content through Astro's language server, not just tsc). Overrides the @nx/js/typescript-inferred target, which fails on this project (see Task 1 report: TS5069 without composite/declaration, then TS2883 from docsSchema()/Zod v4 under declaration-emit).
Preview the static build of the QAuth documentation site (serves dist/apps/docs-site).
